renderer: deterministic p5.js Canvas 2D low-resolution inference plate
memoryRule: a marked cell stays geometrically quiet; commit makes a remote patch swell, a false void open, a neighbouring edge remember, and four errors compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch marks one cell without mutation; Enter, Space, and the miscount control commit; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: cut-out field, pressure stamps, and browser folds -> one low-resolution p5.js cellular raster plate with weighted cells
compositionRupture: off-axis aperture, skewed stamp board, and crooked page -> a dense connected diagonal plate whose uncertainty is carried by gaps and weighted cells
encounterRupture: hold-and-leave, three-mark chord, and page turn -> mark one cell, then make a discrete keyboard/control commitment
temporalRupture: departure absence, pressure misallocation, and false pagination -> generation-like miscount memory that changes the cell rule and persists in four settled stages
mediumRupture: p5.js Canvas 2D cut-outs, p5.js raster stamps, and DOM/CSS folds -> p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D cellular raster drawn from replayable state
changedRule: A marked cell is geometry-neutral. Commit treats it as evidence but spends that evidence elsewhere: a remote patch swells, a false void opens, and a neighbouring edge remembers.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one low-resolution weighted raster plate. A valid mark-and-commit leaves the marked cell exact while remote cells change actual value, weight, offset, notch, and role; four miscounts persist.
falsifier: Delete if marking mutates geometry, if the selected cell is the answer, if remote roles are cosmetic, if the blind plate reads as a generic chart or automaton, if later commits reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v039 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the cellular plate from v036-v038 or if the miscount is not visibly produced in the raster geometry.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
